zh.title: 三起獨立航空事件彙整：雷擊、擋風玻璃裂損與雪梨重飛
zh.summary: THY事件涉及多次雷擊；Eastern的擋風玻璃出現裂損；澳洲航空於雪梨重飛
body: 三起航空事件彼此獨立，資料未指出三者之間有關聯。
1. THY的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年11月25日在Batumi發生事件，涉及多次雷擊。
2. Eastern的波音777-200（ICAO機型代碼B772）於2026年11月25日在大西洋上空發生擋風玻璃裂損事件。
3. 澳洲航空的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年11月25日在雪梨重飛。

en.title: Aviation Roundup: Three Independent Events Involving Lightning, a Cracked Windshield and a Go-Around
en.summary: THY's incident involved multiple lightning strikes; Eastern's Boeing 777-200 had a cracked windshield; Qantas went around at Sydney.
body: Three aviation events are independent, and no relationship among them is stated.
1. A THY Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) was at Batumi on Nov. 25, 2026, in an incident involving multiple lightning strikes.
2. An Eastern Boeing 777-200 (ICAO type code B772) was over the Atlantic on Nov. 25, 2026, in an incident involving a cracked windshield.
3. A Qantas Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) went around at Sydney on Nov. 25, 2026.
